content.short: PLAYA3ULL GAMES centers on play-and-earn games with NFTs for in-game assets on the 3ULL blockchain and prizes in 3ULL Coins.
content.description: PLAYA3ULL GAMES brings together professional game developers to create engaging PC titles. Players can own every in-game asset as an NFT anchored to the 3ULL blockchain, with winnings and rewards issued in 3ULL Coins. The initiative aims to fund and sponsor games from veteran developers around the world. To support this vision, the project operates its own blockchain, has launched network nodes, and uses the 3ULL Coin as the foundational element of its ecosystem.
